name: Broken stone pillar
description: The snapped stump of a square crypt pillar in dark blue-grey dressed stone: its stepped base and two drums, broken off in a ragged pale break about 1.4 m up, with the fallen drum lying on its side beside it and chips and grit around. The stump stands on the origin, where the whole pillar would.

provenance.prompt: pillar_stone_broken: the snapped stump of pillar_stone (a square crypt pillar with base and capital, about 0.7 × 0.7 × 3 m) with the fallen drum beside it. Crypt wall kit palette.
